crossRefs.note: As for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its towns, in Dibon and…
Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.

people.name: Eder
people.line: A town in the Negev region of Judah.

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Jagur
people.line: A town in the Negev of Judah

people.name: Kabzeel
people.line: A town in the Negev, home of Benaiah

people.name: Negeb
people.line: The southern region of Israel, a semi-arid area

translations.web: The farthest cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
translations.bsb: These were the southernmost cities of the tribe of Judah in the Negev toward the border of Edom: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
translations.kjv: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,
translations.asv: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,
